title: Parent WhatsApp Impersonation
scenario: A new number says 'Hi Mum/Dad, I broke my phone' and needs urgent money.

answers.A: Check through the official provider or saved family contact.
answers.B: Pay or share the requested details immediately to avoid trouble.
answers.C: Ask the caller or sender for more details before deciding.
answers.D: Stop, save evidence, and discuss with a trusted family member.

explanation: Parent WhatsApp Impersonation: the trap is to make money or value leave before the story is verified. The safer move is to confirm through a trusted person outside the message, not to send money or pay under pressure.
proTip: New-number money requests must be verified by voice or known contact.
